'''2007 Match Play Championship Day 1 Kevin Elia LS Agents In The Court''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Elia]] at [[2007 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire|JPSD-L-agentsinthecourt.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
